correctness.rationale: Conditional on selecting the same petal of length l, shortest circular distance is uniform on [0,l/2]; across different petals the junction distances add independent uniforms. Independently summed the conditional first and second moments to obtain M1=(2S2-S3)/4 and M2=S3/6+S2^2/8-5S4/24, then V=M2-M1^2. Symbolic differentiation independently reproduced the variance pair-transfer coefficient QV=-5(a^2+ab+b^2)/6+(1/2+3M1/2)(a+b)+S2/2-2M1 and the three-petal polynomial 24QV=9s^3+27s^2t-17s^2-72st+9s+44t. On m=2,3 it is positive because its affine t minimum is at t=0 or t=s^2/4 and both endpoint polynomials are positive. For raw M2 the differential coefficient is ≥s(4-3s)/8>0 for all m. At (1/2,1/2,0,0) the variance transfer coefficient is -1/8, while at equal petals it is positive, proving neither Schur-convexity nor concavity for m≥4 by continuity. Independent Fraction arithmetic verified the exact positive four-petal majorization witness and variance difference -515428427/192000000000000, with both first and second raw moments increasing.
